answer_1.quote: In recent years, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been employed for the task of response generation in human-machine dialogues.
answer_1.outputs: generated responses for dialogue turns or answers

answer_2.quote: To automatically evaluate the quality of the generated text, we have considered BLEU, F1 (i.e. unigram overlap), and ROUGE-L. Furthermore, we have used KF1 to measure the overlap between the prediction and the knowledge selected by the annotators.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 75 annotators on the Prolific platform, and we assigned 5 dialogues to each annotator.
answer_4.guideline: The dimensions can either have a positive or negative answer value, as well as 'I don't know' to avoid forcing erroneous judgments on any of the two sides.
